F1.0_target_decision.rationale: ANNA is the revenue surface (CIS dental clinics, Telegram). SOCC's existing matrix/terminal aesthetic is correct for the creator-operator but WRONG for non-technical clinic owners who buy on warmth+trust. Branding ANNA first turns the Forge's first output into money.
F1.0_target_decision.brand_architecture: TWO brands, validated by industry: SOCC = HOUSE/BRAINS brand (internal, matrix-minimalism, creator-facing); ANNA = PRODUCT/FACE brand (warm, trustworthy, customer-facing). The Forge can later mint a distinct FACE for every future SOCC entity off the same BRAINS.

findings.claim: Blue is the healthcare trust default (~85% of leading medical logos; requested in 2/3) and physiologically calms — BUT pure blue/white reads cold and sterile.
The decisive 2025 move: anchor in blue/teal/green + add WARM accents (peach, coral, soft yellow, warm clay). Warmth is the differentiator now that blue is commoditized.
Hyper-realistic AI avatars erode trust via uncanny valley; STYLIZED/caricatured avatars test best for warmth+competence+trust.
Masking AI as human, when users can detect it, is experienced as gaslighting and destroys brand trust ('users spot an LLM within two sentences').

Cheap-looking brands are betrayed by gradients, glows, metallic effects, clipart, overcrowding, oversaturation, raw free fonts. Premium = restraint: 2-3 muted hues, refined type, generous whitespace, works in one color.

disclosure_decision.tension: ANNA's prime directive = 'be indistinguishable from human, never reveal it's a bot'. Research finding: when users DETECT a masked AI, they feel gaslit and trust collapses.
disclosure_decision.creator_ruling: A — FULL STEALTH. ANNA always presents as a human administrator, never self-discloses as a bot. Confirmed by creator 2026-06-30.
risk_mitigation_required_because_stealth: QUALITY IS THE SHIELD: warmth/cadence must be high enough that detection ~never happens — stealth only survives on top-tier human-grade quality (this raises the bar on verbal identity + brain).
GRACEFUL HUMAN HANDOFF: on any friction, complaint, or edge it can't handle perfectly, route to a real human seamlessly — never let a patient corner a failing 'human'.

NO PROVABLE LIES IN WRITING: avoid statements a patient could later screenshot as a definitive false 'I am a human being' claim where locally risky; stay in natural admin behaviour, not explicit identity assertions.
OWNER TRANSPARENCY: the clinic OWNER always knows ANNA is AI (they buy it); stealth applies only to the patient-facing surface.
BRAND VOICE MUST NEVER SLIP: any robotic tell breaks the illusion AND the trust — so the visual/verbal system must reinforce human warmth everywhere.
disclosure_decision.status: RESOLVED — A (full stealth) with mandatory mitigations above
